tactics.description: Close the distance with clearly signaled lunges, then recover.
tactics.counters: Best against a Surge who keeps their distance, fires Spark-type shots from far away, or camps behind shields and pull fields (lunges break through stationary shield and pull play).

tactics.description: Back off and hold the player at range with hatched hazard tiles and slow orbs.
tactics.counters: Best against a Surge who fights up close, dives in with teleports, or relies on close-range pulse blasts.

tactics.description: Strafe side to side and fire perpendicular volleys. The neutral default.
tactics.counters: Neutral. Use when no distance or power-family habit dominates, or when the evidence is thin.
